summary: Completed testing of P3: Browser push notifications with Service Worker, VAPID keys, notification bell with dropdown, in-app notification storage. All 12 backend tests passed. Frontend notification bell and dropdown working correctly in Admin Dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/push/vapid-key returns VAPID public key correctly (no auth required)
POST /api/push/subscribe stores push subscription for authenticated user with endpoint and keys
GET /api/push/notifications returns user notifications with unread count, properly filtered by user_id/company_id
PUT /api/push/notifications/read marks all notifications as read for the user
POST /api/push/send-test creates a test notification for the current user with bilingual message
Service worker sw-push.js accessible at /sw-push.js with push event handling, notification click handling, and subscription change handling
NotificationBell component in AdminDashboard sidebar with data-testid='notification-bell'
Dropdown shows notifications list, 'Read all' button, 'Enable' push button, and push status indicator
VAPID keys properly configured in backend/.env and frontend/.env (REACT_APP_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY)
seed_data_creation: Test notifications created via POST /api/push/send-test during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: P3 push notifications feature fully tested and working. Backend endpoints: /api/push/vapid-key (public), /api/push/subscribe, /api/push/unsubscribe, /api/push/notifications, /api/push/notifications/read, /api/push/send-test. Frontend: NotificationBell component in AdminDashboard sidebar with dropdown showing notifications, Read all button, Enable push button, and push status. Service worker at /sw-push.js handles browser push events.
